stage: RACE Stage 3: Learned Causal Future-Reuse Ranking
objective: Test whether a calibration-fitted causal ranking model over raw-scale routing features recovers substantially more of the frozen Stage 0 offline-oracle advantage than the frozen Stage 1 winner, using the unchanged Stage 1 eviction mechanism.
motivation: Stage 2 returned RACE_STAGE2_NO_GO. Its diagnostic localized the failure as representational: percentile rank normalization of each adviser separately destroys the magnitude information that the raw-scale Stage 1 hybrid exploits, and re-weighting a rank-normalized pool cannot rebuild it. Stage 3 acts on that finding directly by learning one ranking function over raw causal features instead of adaptively weighting rank-normalized advisers.

stage1_reference.per_sequence_results_reconstruction: The 117.5 MiB aggregate is excluded from version control. It is the byte-exact concatenation, in frozen Stage 0 workload order, of the ten committed per-workload checkpoint files; Stage 3 verifies that reconstruction against the recorded SHA-256 when the aggregate is absent.

stage2_reference.reused: the Stage 2 Markov transition models at horizons 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32, unmodified

inherited_cache_semantics.cache_namespaces: one independent cache per MoE layer
inherited_cache_semantics.admission: all current-request misses are mandatory admissions
inherited_cache_semantics.eviction_rule: retain the capacity-minus-request-size highest-scoring eligible candidates, ordered by score descending, then LRU recency descending, then expert ID ascending

capacity_8_role: degenerate sanity check only; spare residency is zero so no scorer can change any action

scoring_model.form: one linear ranking function per cache capacity over raw causal features
scoring_model.score: S_e = w_B . x_e, larger means retain more strongly
scoring_model.why_not_rank_normalized: Stage 2 established that per-adviser percentile normalization discards magnitude; Stage 3 keeps features on their natural scale
scoring_model.rationale_for_static: Stage 2 measured online Hedge adaptation as worth about 0.8% of cost while tracking the best fixed adviser to within 0.0005 loss per example; Stage 3 spends its complexity budget on the scoring function instead.

families.context: calibration-fitted Markov survival probabilities at horizons 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 averaged over the current atomic request, their band differences, noisy-OR combinations at horizons 2 and 8, and the same two horizons evaluated against the previous same-layer request
families.renewal: log elapsed time since last use, reciprocal elapsed, never-seen indicator, the two most recent inter-arrival gaps, and the overdue ratio elapsed/last-gap
families.windowed_counts: exact counts of the expert in the last 4, 8, 16 and 32 same-layer events
families.decayed: request-indicator EWMA at alpha 0.90, 0.95 and 0.99, gate-weight EWMA at alpha 0.95, last observed gate weight, previous-request indicator
families.request_scope: position within the current decode request, an early-in-request indicator, within-request count and rate, a shrunk within-request rate, and the rate minus static popularity
families.interactions: four fixed products of the above

features.request_scope_disclosure: The request-scope family uses decode-request boundaries, which a serving stack always knows but which no Stage 0, Stage 1 or Stage 2 policy used. Because this is an information source the Stage 1 baseline did not have, a variant WITHOUT that family is preregistered as a mandatory ablation and reported beside the primary.

training.data: the frozen Stage 0 calibration workload path only (80 sequences), disjoint from every evaluation workload
training.unit: one training group is the eligible eviction-candidate set at one sampled decision event at one capacity
training.target: capped next-use distance min(d, 33) in same-layer events, computed offline on the calibration path
training.objective: pairwise logistic ranking loss over within-group ordered pairs (a, b) with target(a) < target(b), each group weighted to contribute equally, at most 30 sampled pairs per group with a fixed seed
training.regularization_selection: the value maximizing pairwise ordering accuracy on the last 20% of calibration groups held out from fitting
training.optimizer: L-BFGS-B on the convex objective, zero initialization, at most 500 iterations
training.standardization: features are centred and scaled by the fitting-set mean and standard deviation; the fitted vector is folded back onto raw feature scale before deployment
rounds: round 1: collect candidate groups under the frozen Stage 1 winner policy, fit ONE pooled model across the four decision capacities
round 2: collect candidate groups under the round-1 model, fit FOUR per-capacity models

STAGE3_RANKER.description: round-2 per-capacity linear ranking models on all 45 features

STAGE3_RANKER_NO_REQUEST_SCOPE.description: identical procedure restricted to the 37 features that use only information available to Stage 1

STAGE3_RANKER_POOLED.description: the round-1 pooled model, isolating the value of per-capacity specialization

STAGE3_RANKER_ROUND1_DATA.description: per-capacity models fitted on round-1 data only, isolating the value of retraining on the deployed policy's own trajectory

evaluation_protocol.workloads: exactly the ten frozen Stage 0 evaluation workload records and orderings used by Stage 1 and Stage 2
evaluation_protocol.runs: one single frozen evaluation after the Stage 3 configuration is sealed
evaluation_protocol.reference_costs: the frozen Stage 1 winner rows, the frozen Stage 0 strongest-simple rows and the frozen Stage 0 oracle rows are read from the sealed archives and never recomputed

metrics.denominator_rule: the oracle-gap denominator always uses the original Stage 0 strongest-simple cost, exactly as in Stage 1 and Stage 2
metrics.zero_denominator_handling: null / N/A when the denominator is zero; capacity 8 never enters a verdict

success_criteria.note: The STRONG and VERY_STRONG rungs are byte-identical to Stage 2 so the three stages remain directly comparable. Stage 2's ladder had no rung between a 10% cost win and failure, which the Stage 2 calibration evidence showed is a wide gap: Condition A is roughly twice as hard as Condition B at every capacity. The PARTIAL rung below was added before any Stage 3 evaluation was run and no threshold was moved to accommodate a measured result.

no_go.rule: any suite-level capacity with C_Stage3 > 1.03 * C_Stage1, or fewer than three non-degenerate capacities with a strictly positive improvement whose paired 95% interval excludes zero

success_criteria.precedence: NO_GO first; then VERY_STRONG_SUCCESS; then STRONG_SUCCESS; then PARTIAL_SUCCESS; then WEAK; otherwise NO_GO

regression_criterion.reporting: every flagged regression is reported even when the aggregate result is positive

required_audits.causality: the feature state is advanced only with events already observed; a future-mutation test must show that changing a later sequence cannot change any earlier action
required_audits.stage1_equivalence: a Stage 3 replay driven by the frozen Stage 1 winner score must reproduce the frozen Stage 1 cost exactly, proving the eviction mechanism is unchanged
required_audits.perfect_score_check: the same mechanism driven by exact next-use scores must reproduce the frozen Stage 0 oracle cost exactly
required_audits.calibration_isolation: no evaluation sequence may enter fitting, feature standardization, static popularity or regularization selection
required_audits.stage0_stage1_stage2_regression: the Stage 0, Stage 1 and Stage 2 test suites must continue to pass unchanged and every sealed archive hash must be unchanged

diagnostics.ranking_quality: pairwise ordering accuracy against the capped and the true next-use distance, pairwise concordance, oracle-consistent and oracle-optimal eviction rates, on the actual candidate sets
diagnostics.accuracy_wall: report the calibration-measured ceiling evidence: pairwise ordering accuracy as a function of model class, feature count, training-set size and model capacity
diagnostics.feature_attribution: report the fitted per-capacity coefficients on standardized features
diagnostics.achievability_frontier: report the calibration-measured non-causal frontier that maps ranking accuracy to oracle-gap closure

statistics.paired_unit: source decode sequence, stratified by domain
statistics.primary_suite_aggregation: At each capacity, sum raw unit-miss costs across all ten frozen workload paths; no per-capacity, per-regime or per-workload variant reselection.
statistics.conditionality: Intervals reweight saved per-sequence contributions conditional on each frozen stateful workload path; stateful cache trajectories are not regenerated under reordered bootstrap workloads.
